sizeNote: Fingerling-sized. CDFW's 2018-2020 Angler Survey Box Analysis reports this as the last recorded stocking at Round Top Lake, in September 2020 — half the quantity of the prior (2018) allotment, a reduction CDFW made given the lake's limited overwintering habitat (measured depth of only 2.1 m/6.9 ft in a 2012 gill-net survey) and resources available for fish. This is a historical, documented event, not a confirmed recurring annual stocking — Round Top Lake does not appear in CDFW's current (2026) Provisional Stocking Document.
